decision: 行业VIX敏感度只在W/V2两个候选分支内部降低组合敞口，再由原有效秩选择器选择分支。

requirements.value: 18 SW L2 technology industries; W and V2 candidate sleeves inherit their frozen ETF mappings

requirements.notes: ETF membership and vendor vintage remain PARTIAL.
Fields are inherited from the frozen W/V2 ledger and copied industry/VIX panels.

requirements.value: VIX is mapped to the latest available A-share close and shifted; month-end guard and selector execute next session
requirements.notes: The source generator maps VIX to the latest available A-share close, shifts by one session, and executes month-end decisions next session.

requirements.value: frozen local snapshots dated 2026-11-16; no vendor revision history claimed
requirements.notes: The package states the frozen-vintage limitation rather than reconstructing a full vendor release chain.

requirements.value: inherited ETF adjusted close, industry returns and VIX index points
requirements.notes: Adjustment and return construction are inherited from the parent branch ledgers; the new layer uses point changes in VIX.

requirements.value: R_i,m=a_i+b_i*DeltaVIX_m+e_i,m over trailing 36 months; selected beta rank is mean percentile of selected industries
requirements.notes: This is a Copeland-like industry-sensitivity proxy, not a claim of exact paper sample reproduction.

requirements.value: VIX 252-day percentile; guard=.5 iff percentile>=.80 and selected beta percentile<=.5
requirements.notes: Beta uses 36 monthly observations; the guard uses the frozen 80% VIX percentile and 50% selected-beta percentile thresholds.
Signal dates come from the frozen month-end holdings and selections; portfolio effects start on the next trading session.

requirements.value: RISK_VIX is applied independently inside both W and V2; the original effective-rank selector then chooses W or V2
requirements.notes: The guard is applied separately to both candidate sleeves before the unchanged selector maps the monthly state to W or V2.

requirements.value: guarded exposure=original exposure*guard; no leverage; multipliers in {0.5,1.0}
requirements.notes: Original branch exposure is multiplied by a guard in {0.5,1.0}; the replay checks bounds and does not add leverage.

requirements.value: monthly selector choice; inherited daily risk exposure updates
requirements.notes: The selector changes at month starts from the frozen schedule; inherited daily branch exposure updates remain unchanged.

requirements.value: inherited close-to-close branch returns with bond residual; no new intraday fill model
requirements.notes: The publication replays frozen net branch returns rather than order-level fills.

requirements.value: long-only, exposure bounded at one, inherited tradability and ETF mapping
requirements.notes: The new multiplier reduces exposure only and cannot create leverage or new instruments.
The 10bp cost case charges 10bp on all branch turnover and still charges the separate 10bp W/V2 switch.
All package candidates use the same 1767-day frozen branch axis.

requirements.value: EFFECTIVE_RANK_HIGH_W@R20261116 and an average-guard exposure-matched control
requirements.notes: The baseline is the effective-rank parent; the additionally matched control holds average guard exposure constant across time.

requirements.value: missing beta/state fails the replay; no adjustment if upstream guard is 1.0
requirements.notes: The replay requires complete beta and state rows and fails closed instead of inventing a guard.

requirements.value: point-estimate improvement is separate from statistical confirmation; 95% Sharpe-delta interval must exclude zero
requirements.notes: Point-estimate improvement, cost robustness and block-bootstrap confirmation are recorded separately.

requirements.value: frozen branch ledgers and causal monthly selections; source generator shifts VIX and executes next session
requirements.notes: Published replay can verify accounting, not independently reconstruct every vendor input.

decisions.decision: Keep the candidate as SHADOW_ONLY because both 21-day block-bootstrap intervals include zero.
